name: cinecast-tv
description: CineCast — LG webOS TV streaming app

scripts.webos:package: npm run icons && ares-package webos --outdir dist
scripts.webos:dev: npm run icons && ares-package webos --outdir dist && ares-install --device tv dist/com.cinecast.tv_1.0.0_all.ipk && ares-launch --device tv com.cinecast.tv
